publicDistribution.rule: Public loader, registry and immutable component artifacts must never depend on or forward YXSGIT Basic credentials.

injectedCapabilities.rule: Optional capability objects are supplied by the host page in its existing identity and permission context; the component treats them as opaque context and must not create a second authentication surface.

requirements: Keep the realm stable for resources that belong to one hosted authentication boundary.
Let the browser reuse successful Basic credentials for same-origin pages, modules and projection resources.
Component code must not construct, persist or forward Basic Authorization headers.
Cross-origin public component fetches use credentials=omit.

longLivedSession.objective: One interactive authentication, then long-lived silent reuse across related hosted sites.
longLivedSession.recommendedModel: Exchange successful Basic bootstrap for an opaque server-side session; store only an HttpOnly Secure session cookie, never the Basic password.
constraints: Do not rely on Basic itself for a server-controlled multi-day cache lifetime.
Use explicit expiry, rotation and revocation.
Only share a parent-domain cookie when all sibling hosts are one trust boundary; otherwise use a central auth host with silent host-specific session minting.
Do not expose the session token to JavaScript.
